annotations.title: CSRD scope and first reporting year

description: Returns the CSRD verdict per financial year under Directive (EU) 2022/2464 as amended by the Stop-the-clock Directive (EU) 2025/794 and Omnibus I Directive (EU) 2026/470, with the size test and the third-country test shown separately. Use it when someone asks: does CSRD apply to my company, do we have to report under CSRD, are we in scope after the Omnibus, did the postponement take us out of scope, when is our first CSRD report due, which reporting wave are we in, do the 1,000 employee and turnover thresholds catch us, are we a large undertaking, does CSRD apply to a non-EU or US parent with EU subsidiaries, which ESRS standard applies to us, do we need limited or reasonable assurance, do we have to report for financial year 2026 or 2027.

employees.description: Average employees during the financial year.

established_in_eu.description: Is the undertaking established in the EU? Default true. Set false to run the third-country test instead.

eu_subsidiary_turnover_eur.description: Third-country test only: turnover of the EU subsidiary or branch.

group_eu_turnover_eur.description: Third-country test only: group turnover generated in the EU, current year.

group_eu_turnover_prior_year_eur.description: Third-country test only: the same figure for the prior year.

member_state_used_the_postponement_optio.description: Has the Member State used the Omnibus I option for financial years beginning 1 Jan 2025 to 31 Dec 2026? Default false.

securities_listed_on_an_eu_regulated_mar.description: Listed on an EU regulated market. Default false.

name: csrd_scope
